name: Plate CDXXXII: The Phoenix
description: The Bennu, the bird of Heliopolis, that burns upon its nest of spices and rises again from its own ashes: the alchemists' sign of the reddened Stone. Struck in Phoenix Flame: the fire the Bennu kindles from its own wings. One of the Seven Hierophants: a single plate, composed by hand, of which there is no other.
